description: Ember-only mode: Thunderbird keeps running (accounts, sync, sending) with its own window hidden.

functions.name: configure
functions.description: Turn Ember-only mode and the lighter Thunderbird settings on or off.

functions.name: showThunderbird
functions.description: Show and focus Thunderbird's main window (opening one if none exists).

functions.name: titlebar
functions.description: For the calling page's window: draw under the title bar (Ember's own window) and say how much room to leave at the top.

functions.name: setDockIcon
functions.description: Ember's icon in the Dock while Ember-only mode is on: save the picture (base64 PNG) and show it or not. Returns whether it's shown.

functions.name: openAccountSetup
functions.description: Show Thunderbird's main window with its account setup (to add an email account).

functions.name: hideThunderbird
functions.description: In Ember-only mode, hide Thunderbird's main windows again.

functions.name: focusSpark
functions.description: Restore (if minimized) and focus the Ember window. windows.update can't un-minimize while Thunderbird isn't the active app.

functions.name: state
functions.description: Current mode and whether a Thunderbird main window is visible.

events.name: onOpenMessage
events.description: In Ember-only mode, Thunderbird was asked to show a message (for example a new-mail notification was clicked); Ember should open it.

events.name: onReopen
events.description: Thunderbird tried to bring its main window back while in Ember-only mode (for example a new main window opened); Ember should show itself instead.
